title: OFast-X Plugin PRD
description: Product Requirements Document for the OFast-X WordPress plugin, covering all modules and core features.

features.name: Admin UI Enhancements
features.description: Improve the WordPress admin interface with custom designs and usability tweaks.

features.name: Security Hardening
features.description: Add security features such as honeypot, math captcha, nonce, rate limiter, and sanitizer.

features.name: Email Notifications
features.description: Send transactional and notification emails using customizable templates and SMTP integration.

features.name: Custom Dashboard
features.description: Provide a custom dashboard experience for site administrators.

features.name: Content Ordering
features.description: Allow custom ordering of posts, pages, or custom post types.

features.name: Spam Protection
features.description: Protect forms and comments from spam using multiple techniques.

features.name: Social Login Integration
features.description: Allow users to log in using social media accounts.

features.name: User Role Management
features.description: Manage and customize user roles and capabilities.

features.name: Snippets Management
features.description: Add and manage custom code snippets.

features.name: Logger Utility
features.description: Log important plugin events and errors.

features.name: Email Templates
features.description: Provide customizable email templates for various notifications.

acceptance_criteria: All modules load without PHP errors or warnings.
Admin UI is responsive and matches design requirements.
Security features block common attack vectors.
Emails are sent and received as expected using SMTP.
Custom dashboard and menu features are accessible to admins.
Spam protection is effective on all forms.
Social login works for supported providers.
User roles and capabilities can be managed from the admin panel.
Redirects are processed correctly and logged.
Snippets can be added, edited, and removed safely.
License activation and validation work as intended.
